steps.text: 22 Years Ago
8:05 P.M. \ Cloudy
Central Sargon, Ibut Region, Town of Reefsteep, Surroundings

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: An abandoned courtyard... Is this where you live?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: A few years ago, a merchant built the magnificent courtyard before you, but he disappeared without a trace during a business trip. To this day, no one knows whether he met his fate in a natural Catastrophe or man-made tragedy.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: But whichever the case, this courtyard has become a place of refuge for those of us with nowhere to go.

steps.name: Homeless Person
steps.text: Old Isin brought two new faces with him...

steps.name: Homeless Person
steps.text: She doesn't seem all that poor, going by her looks...

steps.name: Disheveled Person
steps.text: We need to be careful... Let's head back inside. We shouldn't pry into Old Isin's secrets.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What's this courtyard called...?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: (Sargonian) 'The Sleeping Sargon.' That's what all those without a home have come to call this place...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Just like our fallen homeland, my lady. We sleep on the most extravagant corpse you can find in the whole world.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Please stay the night and wait until sunrise. Only then can we leave for the heart of Reefsteep.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The land encircled by reefs.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Precisely... Right in the center of the sea of sands.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The padishah and lord ameer chose to rebuild their city somewhere with far richer resources, leaving it a forgotten ruin, a land of lawlessness.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Be that as it may, to those who once lived in that city as well as their descendants, leaving that place behind is easier said than done.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: You can hire underground Messengers to do your bidding there. They will create fake identities for you and help you leave Sargon territory.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: However, your destination is quite some distance away. Old Isin cannot guarantee you will arrive in one piece.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: How is Elliot doing?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: He is asleep, but it is safe here. You care for him more than Old Isin imagined you would. It is proof of your kindness.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He's not going to be happy if he catches you say that.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Oh, Old Isin can see it... The anger lurking in him.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I thought you'd have met plenty of people like him. Civil unrests and skirmishes happen often in Sargon, after all.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: The world may think there are many brave men with a lust for revenge, but there isn't. Most merely drown in their hatred, their rationality quashed by their anger.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I can save him this once, and only this once.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Yes... Old Isin understands... His fate lies elsewhere... and his fate is bound to that gold coin of yours.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Why 22 years?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Arts cannot give us so-called prophecies, and no mere mortal can manipulate time. Time is the mother of all fates. All Old Isin likes to do is to wager against time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So you mean... Hm, what's wrong?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Dissatisfied hisses)

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Ah... What a beautiful creature.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin can tell. The two of you depend on one another. Old Isin can tell... it is your partner.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: The two of you have traveled a long, long journey together.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's go, Mon3tr. Let's go see them.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Oh... You communicate... Your hearts are connected.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin can feel that... you have complete trust in this creature... as though it is your one and only friend...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Yet... you traveled on your long, arduous journey with no one but this beautiful creature...?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Lady, is this glory of yours replete with nothing but loneliness?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Loneliness doesn't affect my responsibilities in any way...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It seems we've got company. I'll go take care of them. Please stay here. Take care of Elliot.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Of course. Old Isin has ways to hide. After all, Old Isin has been hiding for far too long.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Where's Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Enemies are abound. She is fending them off with her trusted partner.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You mean that weird creature...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Why are you looking into the distance like that? Are you worried about her?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: No, Old Isin is not worried. She has a tenacious spirit. Old Isin thinks not even death can stop her in her tracks, that's why Old Isin respects her. Old Isin has a question for her...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: What do you want to ask her...?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: For the past hundred and some years... Old Isin has had the same dream again and again.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: In those dreams, there stands a magnificent city among the golden sands. The city moves, and the sky seen from its towers is purer and clearer than ever...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: The young pasha stands next to Old Isin, and there is always a vast, empty swath of land before our eyes. The young padishah would always begin to recount to Old Isin...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Yet Old Isin is too old... Old Isin forgets. Old Isin's crimes are unforgivable.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: (He's talking to himself again...)

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin has always sought this answer. Old Isin has been waiting for someone who knows of the city and its glory.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: All those who had to do with the city yet live in the dream. Some have forgotten, but a great many of us still look back fondly on our homeland...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: We built this city with our own hands under the padishah's leadership. A great city. Even if Catastrophes bring it to its ruins, that city is the true beginning of the Land of Reefsteep...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: The Sargonians of Ibut must never forget anything about Reefsteep... yet... Old Isin has forgotten... Old Isin is unforgivable.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You've been waiting for someone... to tell you what you've forgotten in your dreams?

a.text: The old fortune teller turns around, his smell ever rotten. His facial features are strange, and his bare fingers certainly do not resemble his actual age.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Roars)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You're the leader of those squads... I remember you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: How did you find us, Columbian?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sarkaz... I'm not from Columbia.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sarkaz Tribal Dialect)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Hmm—?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What's going on... Are you trying to control my mind?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Fire! Stop her Arts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sarkaz Tribal Dialect)

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Shrieks)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What...? Not even the highest grade arrows could harm that monster?!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We don't have enough info to work with... She seems to be a Caster. Be careful!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sarkaz... The Lord Ameer of Ibut hired you, didn't he?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You think I'm about to tell you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No... The Ibuti Lord Ameer has a deep, personal grudge against Victoria. I only got a brief glimpse, so it's possible I'm mistaken, but the arrows just now were indeed Victorian.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Looks like your real employer... The current padishah, Murad, is far more crafty than I expected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A patient ruler, fanning the flames between the different forces without a care in the world. Perhaps he had anticipated the plans of the Columbians and the local lords ameer all along?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Heh, you know about the padishah, and still you dare come to Sargon? I'll never know what's going on in you Columbians' heads. What, you got Originium in your brain?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Padishah Murad wants just the box and nothing else. Give it to us, and all of us get to leave this place alive.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You haven't destroyed it, have you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only because it isn't mine.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Heh... You're a stubborn one.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: The Ibuti Lord Ameer's self-righteousness earned him the padishah's anger. I have no idea who hired those Columbian mercenaries, but I can at least tell you they won't be putting up a fight anymore.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: This pointless war is coming to an end soon. Padishah Murad gave us the authority to bring all this to an end.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If that were the case, why would an almighty Sargon padishah hire mercenaries to do his bidding here, instead of sending his personal guards?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: This has got way too much to do with Columbia, after all, but none of that matters to you and me right now. You got a decision to make here, Operations Adviser.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: All you gotta know is that there's no one coming to save you in this desert.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Lightly stretches body)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: (Watch out for that creature. No idea what it actually is, but it's gonna be tricky to take it down.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sarkaz Tribal Dialect)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: —No, it can't be! This isn't just normal Arts—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Devil speak? You're a Columbian! How—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: (Sargonian) Enough!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: (Sargonian) Talk to us in Victorian or Sargonian, or else we'll shoot!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you from Kazdel?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Kazdel...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Just a bedtime story for kids. I have no idea what you have to do with Sarkaz, but this doesn't change anything about the situation we're in.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Be quick with it and hand the box over. All the padishah wants is the tech.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This will set off the beginning of Sargon's destruction. Padishah Murad is not a scientist. He doesn't understand the devastation it can cause.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: He doesn't need to understand, nor do we.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is Sargon your homeland, Sarkaz?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I've lived in Sargon for as long as I can remember.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: We snuck around in the back alleys and hid our horns, and we lived in the filthiest of places.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Picking up arms is the only way we get to eat. It's simple. All of us are practically natural-born Infected. It's do or die, and that's what drives us.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Tsk—So what are you saying?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only Sarkaz with a firm will can escape the ancient language's influence. The language itself is a kind of Sarkaz witchery. What's the source of your conviction? Your mission, or your greed?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Well, I gotta admit... Your mind trick might actually have worked. I still haven't ordered anyone to open fire. I'm still chitchatting with you with all the patience in the world, even.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All I can see before me is a Sarkaz trying his best to survive using the simplest method he knows.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Looks around on alert)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Enough of this crap. I thought you were a Columbian mercenary leader. Stop pussyfooting around!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Padishah Murad won't allow any Sarkaz to know his dirtiest secrets.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You fought off all the other squads vying for this trophy. Don't you suppose the lords ameer's men were not among them, masquerading as mercenaries?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And between the exorbitant amounts in taxes and the lives of a few Sarkaz assassins, what do you think Padishah Murad's choice will be?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Of course we're aware of that, but if we let you go now, does that mean we'll be raking in even more dough, or our Oripathy will be cured right away?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Don't get the wrong idea. We live at the padishah's mercy. We don't have a choice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Perhaps I can give you a choice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Sarkaz Tribal Dialect)

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Hmph—You want to turn us against him, and you want us to serve—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: —Serve Kazdel... a place we haven't so much as seen...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Don't make me laugh, Caster! The Sarkaz homeland? There's nothing there but a bunch of ruins! You bookworm types should know better than any of us just how much is left of Kazdel!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: (Get the Casters ready. Focus your fire on that monster. You two, we'll take the bitch down the first opportunity we got.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Too bad. Looks like negotiation's not on the table anymore.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: This isn't even negotiation—Tsk, what is this even, mercy? You're the one who's surrounded right now!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Yeah, you're right... You know how to strike fear, but if we don't give the padishah an answer he's satisfied with by tomorrow, we aren't going to escape death either.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Just like I told you, we don't have a choice.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Open fire!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: What's that behind the smoke...? Is that the monster?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Not even a scratch...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: You, 'Kazdel' Caster. What are you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You didn't have to be someone else's tool.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I want to live.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Besides, this is how it's always been. A Sarkaz has no right to dream about the future.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Draw your blades! Attack!
